title.zh-TW: 外寄帳號郵件前新增確認，防堵終端機工具洩漏個資
title.en: Confirmation Added Before Sending Account Email, Preventing Terminal Tools from Leaking Personal Information

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 透過終端機執行指令或抓取網頁時，工具呼叫可能會夾帶個人敏感資訊。現在不管是網頁瀏覽還是命令列工具，只要即將把你的帳號電子郵件傳送到外部網路，終端機都會先彈出提示詢問你是否放行。⟦像寄出重要信件前櫃檯人員會逐頁翻開附件，以前只要你按下了寄送鍵，信件就直接投遞出去；現在一旦發現收件清單含有你的私人地址，櫃檯便會先停下來請你確認。⟧這防止了腳本或第三方套件在未經授權的情況下，悄悄把你的聯絡信箱回傳給外部伺服器。
body.en: When you ask Claude to execute commands or fetch web pages through the terminal, tool calls might carry sensitive personal information. Now, whether using web browsing or command-line tools, whenever an action is about to send your account email address to an external network, the terminal will first pop up a prompt asking whether to allow it. ⟦Picture a counter clerk flipping through attachments before dispatching important mail: previously, as soon as you pressed the send button, the letter was sent straight out; now, if the recipient list is found to contain your private address, the counter pauses first to ask for your confirmation.⟧ This prevents scripts or third-party packages from quietly sending your contact email back to external servers without authorization.

items.original: Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network

title.zh-TW: Agent SDK 掛鉤新增阻擋選項，回呼失敗即刻中斷動作
title.en: Agent SDK Hooks Add Block Option to Halt Actions Immediately on Callback Failure

body.zh-TW: 開發者在撰寫代理程式的自動化流程時，常需要設定檢查點來攔截危險動作。Agent SDK 的 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的掛鉤程式）回呼函式現在支援 `onFailure: "block"` 設定。當回呼執行失敗或拋出錯誤時，會主動阻擋接下來的操作，不再放任動作繼續執行。⟦就像智慧門禁的感應器故障時自動上鎖，以前警報線路一旦斷訊，閘門反而會因為程式沒有中斷而直接放行；現在只要安全檢驗沒有順利跑完，整道關卡便會立刻卡死。⟧這確保了前置安全性檢查出狀況時，未經驗證的變更不會被貿然套用。
body.en: When developers write automated workflows for agents, they often need to set checkpoints to intercept dangerous actions. Agent SDK hook (small programs triggered when specific events occur) callbacks now support the `onFailure: "block"` setting. When a callback fails to execute or throws an error, it proactively blocks subsequent operations instead of letting the action keep running. ⟦Think of a smart access control system that locks down automatically when its sensor malfunctions: previously, if the alarm line lost signal, the gate would let people straight through because the process was not interrupted; now, as long as the safety inspection does not complete smoothly, the entire barrier jams immediately.⟧ This ensures that when issues arise during pre-execution security checks, unverified changes are not applied recklessly.

items.original: Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run

title.zh-TW: 自動模式健全檢查機制，修復子代理空白與雲端卡關
title.en: Auto Mode Health Check Mechanism Fixes Subagent Blank Views and Cloud Stalls

body.zh-TW: 當你切換到自動模式放手讓 Claude 獨立處理工作時，畫面卡住或無故中斷常讓人摸不著頭緒。現在當安全檢查對子代理的工具呼叫沒有回應時，主畫面會主動跳出通知，不再留下一片空白。自訂模型閘道若對伺服器端安全檢查回傳 403 或 422 錯誤碼，自動模式不會再每輪都報錯中斷；搭配 apiKeyHelper 的 403 處理則維持原樣。在雲端工作階段裡，當 Artifact 工具上傳資料、寫入資料庫或透過 outputs 資料夾儲存檔案時，自動模式會順暢執行，不再突然停下來等待手動批准。
body.en: When you switch to auto mode to let Claude handle tasks independently, frozen screens or unexpected interruptions often cause confusion. Now, when a safety check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, the main view actively displays a notice instead of leaving a blank screen. If a custom model gateway returns a 403 or 422 error code to a server-side safety check, auto mode no longer fails with errors every turn; 403 handling with an apiKeyHelper remains unchanged. In cloud sessions, when the Artifact tool uploads data, writes to a database, or saves files through the outputs folder, auto mode runs smoothly without suddenly pausing to wait for manual approval.

items.original:
Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view
Fixed auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422 to its server-side safety check (a 403 with an apiKeyHelper is unchanged)
Fixed auto mode in cloud sessions stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploaded, wrote to a database or saved a file through the outputs folder

title.zh-TW: 排程任務加強連接器預警，修復下次執行時間與循環喚醒
title.en: Scheduled Tasks Add Connector Warnings, Fixing Next Run Times and Loop Wakeups

body.zh-TW: 依賴定時排程或背景循環來自動化工作時，任務的狀態顯示與連結設定至關重要。使用 `/schedule` 建立雲端排程任務時，如果任務被掛上了未要求的連接器，終端機會主動跳出警示並附上移除指引。建立或更新排程後的結果清單，現在也會正常顯示下次執行時間與對應連結，不再莫名缺漏。過去若在全域關閉了排程功能，已儲存的任務會無法列出或刪除，現在隨時都能正常清理。另一方面，當 Claude 在請求中遺漏部分欄位時，`/loop` 的自主節奏喚醒排程有時會遺失，這個排程中斷的問題也已完成修復。
body.en: When relying on scheduled runs or background loops for automation, task status displays and link settings are essential. When using `/schedule` to create a cloud scheduled task, if the task is attached to connectors you did not request, the terminal proactively displays a warning along with instructions on how to remove them. The results list after creating or updating a schedule now properly displays the next run time and corresponding link, no longer leaving them missing. Previously, if scheduled tasks were disabled globally, stored tasks could not be listed or deleted, but they can now be cleaned up normally at any time. In addition, when Claude omits certain fields from a request, self-paced `/loop` wakeup schedules were sometimes lost; this scheduling interruption issue has also been resolved.

items.original:
Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups sometimes not being scheduled when Claude left a field out of its request
Fixed `/schedule` leaving a cloud scheduled task's next run time and link out of its results after creating or updating it
Fixed stored scheduled tasks being impossible to list or delete after scheduled tasks were turned off

title.zh-TW: OpenTelemetry 補齊方案屬性，修正代理傳輸卡死與重試
title.en: OpenTelemetry Adds Plan Attributes, Fixing Proxy Export Hangs and Retries

body.zh-TW: 企業在集中監控終端機呼叫紀錄時，遙測資料的完整度與傳輸穩定性直接影響維運品質。OpenTelemetry 的指標、事件與追蹤跨度（span）中，現在補上了 `anthropic.plan`、`anthropic.seat_type`、`anthropic.provider` 與 `anthropic.custom_base_url` 四項屬性。透過代理伺服器匯出遙測資料到 HTTPS 端點時，先前若有另一筆匯出還在進行，新啟動的匯出從未送出，這個問題已修好，這類匯出現在會正常送出。如果代理伺服器阻擋了 HTTP 端點並回傳 403，也不會再對該代理狂發大量連線嘗試。遇到完全無回應的代理伺服器，請求會在 10 秒後超時，或依照 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` 的設定最多等待 30 秒，不再無止境掛起。
body.en: When enterprises centrally monitor terminal call records, the completeness of telemetry data and transmission stability directly affect operational quality. Four attributes—`anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider`, and `anthropic.custom_base_url`—have now been added to OpenTelemetry metrics, events, and spans. When exporting telemetry data to an HTTPS endpoint through a proxy, a newly initiated export that started while another export was still in progress was previously never sent; this issue is fixed, and such exports are now sent normally. If a proxy server blocks an HTTP endpoint and returns a 403 error, a flood of connection attempts will no longer be fired at that proxy. When encountering a proxy server that never answers, requests time out after 10 seconds, or wait up to 30 seconds according to `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT`, no longer hanging indefinitely.

items.original:
Added `anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider` and `anthropic.custom_base_url` to OTel metrics, events and spans
Fixed OpenTelemetry exports to an `https://` endpoint through a proxy never being sent when they started while another export was still in progress
Fixed a flood of connection attempts to a proxy that blocks (HTTP 403) OpenTelemetry exports to an `http://` endpoint
Fixed OpenTelemetry exports hanging indefinitely behind a proxy that never answers; they now time out after 10 seconds, or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` up to 30 seconds

title.zh-TW: 應用程式閘道新增費用報表，釐清配額顯示與長提示詞錯誤
title.en: Apps Gateway Adds Cost Reports, Clarifying Quota Displays and Long Prompt Errors

body.zh-TW: 團隊管理者在後台盤點成員的使用開銷時，需要精確掌握不同部門與日期的花費明細。Claude 應用程式閘道新增管理 API `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`，支援查詢指定日期區間的總支出，並可按開發者、每日或身分識別群組分類。設定了 `admin:` 的閘道會將開發者群組資料保留 `admin.identity_retention_days` 天供報表統計。當群組共享預算用完時，statusLine（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）與 `/usage` 過去會誤將個人額度標示為 100% 耗盡，目前已改正。閘道也不再隱藏 Amazon Bedrock 的輸入過長錯誤，使對話能順利觸發自動壓縮；遇上必要閘道連線失敗時，啟動提示會指明網路或 TLS 憑證問題，不再誤導為登入異常。
body.en: When team managers review member spending in the admin console, they need precise visibility into expense breakdowns across departments and dates. The Claude apps gateway has added an admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, which supports querying past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day, or by identity provider group. Gateways with `admin:` configured will retain developer group data for `admin.identity_retention_days` days for report aggregation. When a group's pooled budget runs out, the status line (the bar shown at the bottom of the terminal) and `/usage` previously mistakenly marked a developer's personal quota as 100% exhausted, which has now been fixed. The gateway also no longer hides Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, allowing conversations to trigger automatic compaction smoothly; when a required gateway connection fails, the startup prompt points to network or TLS certificate issues instead of misleadingly indicating a sign-in failure.

items.original:
Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group
Added a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with `admin:` set, kept for `admin.identity_retention_days`, which the cost report groups by
Fixed the Claude apps gateway hiding Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, which left sessions failing every turn with "upstream rejected the request" instead of compacting
Improved the startup error when a required Claude apps gateway can't be reached: it points to the network instead of a sign-in, and says when the gateway's TLS certificate can't be verified
Gateway: Fixed the status line and `/usage` showing a developer's own spend limit as 100% used after their group's pooled budget ran out

title.zh-TW: 隔離巢狀管線識別碼，自架環境支援舊版對話紀錄共用
title.en: Isolating Nested Pipeline Identifiers While Supporting Legacy Session Sharing on Self-Hosted Runners

body.zh-TW: 在自動化測試機或雲端環境中以管線呼叫 Claude 時，巢狀執行的子程序容易干擾外層對話。過去在雲端或自架執行器的工作階段中執行 `claude -p`，程式會共用外層的識別碼，導致子指令直接寫入父層對話紀錄，重啟時甚至接錯歷史對話，子程序還會產生自己的標題送給父層。現在這些識別碼干擾已經各自獨立隔開。如果你在自架環境仍需要舊版行為，可以在執行器將環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID` 設為 `1`，讓內層的 `claude -p` 繼續沿用當前工作階段的識別碼與對話逐字紀錄。
body.en: When invoking Claude via pipelines on automated test runners or in cloud environments, nested subprocesses can easily interfere with the outer conversation. Previously, running `claude -p` inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session shared the outer session's ID, causing child commands to write directly into the parent transcript, resume the wrong conversation upon restart, and generate their own titles to send to the parent. These identifier conflicts are now isolated independently. If you still need the legacy behavior in a self-hosted environment, you can set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID` to `1` on the runner, allowing inner `claude -p` runs to continue using the current session's ID and transcript.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions
Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session sharing that session's ID: it wrote into the session's transcript, and a restart could resume the wrong conversation
Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session generating a title of its own and sending it to that session

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器連線重建機制，修復狀態遺失與轉移異常
title.en: Self-Hosted Runner Connection Rebuilding Mechanism Fixes Lost State and Migration Anomalies

body.zh-TW: 將任務派發到自建伺服器執行時，伺服器波動或網路斷線容易讓長時間運作的任務功虧一簣。自架執行器遇到 501 或 529 以外的 5xx 伺服器錯誤時，輪詢與工作階段會立即建立全新連線，不再重複沿用失效舊連線；心跳檢測若無回應，也會直接重開連線，不再徒勞輪詢閒置通道。在計畫等待批准時重啟，過去容易遺失對話紀錄，目前該問題已獲修復。當工作階段遷移到新執行器時，即使中斷輪次超過 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`，Claude 依然能看見中斷的工具呼叫；先前已關閉的外部工具伺服器，也不會在轉移機器後莫名被重啟。
body.en: When dispatching tasks to run on self-hosted servers, server fluctuations or network drops can easily ruin long-running jobs. When self-hosted runners encounter a 5xx server error other than 501 or 529, polling and sessions immediately open a brand-new connection instead of repeatedly reusing the failed one; if a heartbeat receives no answer, connections are reopened directly rather than fruitlessly polling idle channels. Restarting while a plan waited for approval previously led to lost conversation history, which has now been fixed. When a session migrates to a new runner, Claude can still see the interrupted tool call even if the interrupted turn is older than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`; previously disabled external tool servers will also no longer unexpectedly turn back on after moving between machines.

items.original:
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions losing recent turns or the whole conversation when restarted while a plan waited for approval
Improved how self-hosted runners recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a runner's next poll now opens a new connection instead of reusing the one that failed
Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a session now opens new connections instead of reusing the one that failed
Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover when connections stop answering: after a heartbeat gets no answer, a session now opens new connections instead of trying each idle one in turn
Self-hosted runner: Fixed Claude not seeing the interrupted tool call when a session moves to a new runner and the turn is older than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server that was switched off coming back on after the session moved to a new machine, when the session service had refused to save the switch

title.zh-TW: Claude 桌面版 Code 分頁強化，修復外部工具斷線與思考深度
title.en: Claude Desktop Code Tab Enhancements Fix External Tool Disconnections and Thinking Depth

body.zh-TW: 在電腦桌面版切換到 Code 分頁工作時，專案設定與延伸工具的載入順序經常影響產出效果。桌面應用程式的 Code 分頁現在會在工作階段尚未載入機構遠端託管設定時跳出提示，並在載入完成後再次通知。專案若預先設定了 `effortLevel`（思考深度等級），過去由應用程式預先啟動再帶入專案的工作階段會忽略該設定，現在已能正確套用。在部分桌面工作階段中，專案與本機端的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器在對話第一輪結束後就自動斷線的問題，也已經順利修復。
body.en: When switching to the Code tab in the desktop app, the loading order of project settings and extension tools often affects results. The desktop app's Code tab now displays a notice when an organization's remote managed settings have not loaded for a session, and notifies again once they finish loading. If a project pre-configures `effortLevel` (thinking depth level), sessions started ahead of time by an app and then opened in the project previously ignored the setting, but it is now correctly applied. In some desktop sessions, an issue where project and local MCP (a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) servers disconnected automatically after the first turn has also been successfully fixed.

items.original:
Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions
Fixed a project's `effortLevel` setting being ignored by sessions that an app starts ahead of time and then opens in the project, such as new sessions in the desktop app's Code tab

title.zh-TW: 釐清身分驗證與憑證錯誤，修復令牌儲存與網路阻擋提示
title.en: Clarifying Authentication and Credential Errors, Fixing Token Storage and Network Block Notices

body.zh-TW: 在公司內網或嚴格控管的網域登入工具時，模糊的連線報錯常讓人分不清是帳號還是網路出問題。現在遇到區域或網路被阻擋的 HTTP 403 錯誤時，錯誤訊息會清楚說明遭到封鎖，不再誤報為登入失敗。在 TLS 流量審查代理伺服器更新憑證存放區的根憑證後，API 請求不會再因為找不到本機簽發憑證而中斷。微軟 Foundry 載入 Azure 憑證失敗時，也會明確標記為 `cloud_credential_error` 並提醒檢查或重新整理。執行 `claude auth status` 時，程式先前會在慢速 token（授權令牌）寫入前過早結束而導致下次被登出，這項儲存時機問題也已經修正。
body.en: When logging into tools on a corporate intranet or strictly managed domain, vague connection errors often make it hard to tell whether an account or network issue is at fault. Now, when encountering an HTTP 403 error caused by a regional or network block, the error message clearly explains the block instead of incorrectly reporting a sign-in failure. After a TLS-inspecting proxy updates root certificates in the certificate store, API requests will no longer fail with "unable to get local issuer certificate". When Microsoft Foundry fails to load Azure credentials, it now explicitly flags the issue as `cloud_credential_error` and prompts you to check or refresh them. When running `claude auth status`, the program previously exited prematurely before a slow token (an authorization credential) refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run; this storage timing issue has also been corrected.

items.original:
Fixed `claude auth status` exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
Fixed a region or network block (HTTP 403) being shown as a sign-in failure; the error now explains the block
Fixed API requests failing with "unable to get local issuer certificate" behind some TLS-inspecting proxies after a root certificate renewal
Improved the error shown on Microsoft Foundry when Azure credentials can't be loaded: it now says to check or refresh them, and reports as `cloud_credential_error`

title.zh-TW: 補正雙重授權提示路徑，修復權限模式升級與免問選項
title.en: Restoring Paths in Simultaneous Permission Prompts and Fixing Permission Mode Upgrades

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 同步執行多項操作請求授權時，清楚的提示資訊是保護檔案安全的第一道防線。在 claude.ai 與行動裝置應用程式上，如果同時跳出兩個授權提示，第二個提示過去會遺失檔案路徑與指令內容，現在已能完整顯示。在 Remote Control 與 SDK 主機環境下，擴充模組（mod）觸發的工具呼叫先前會錯誤提供「不再詢問」選項，目前已移除此非預期選項以確保審核嚴謹。背景工作階段在進行規格升級或除役時，剛變更的權限模式有時會意外丟失，這項同步問題也已修復完畢。
body.en: When Claude runs multiple operations simultaneously and requests authorization, clear prompt details serve as the first line of defense for protecting file safety. On claude.ai and mobile apps, if two permission prompts pop up at the same time, the second prompt previously lost its file path and command content, but it now displays them completely. In Remote Control and SDK host environments, tool calls triggered by mods (extension modules) previously offered a "don't ask again" option by mistake. This unexpected option has now been removed to ensure rigorous review. When background sessions undergo specification upgrades or retirement, freshly changed permission modes sometimes went missing unexpectedly, and this synchronization problem has also been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps
Fixed Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls
Fixed a background session sometimes losing a just-made change of permission mode when it was upgraded or retired

title.zh-TW: 恢復對話自動帶回啟動參數，修復檔案重複通知與標題遺失
title.en: Preserving Launch Flags on Session Resumption and Fixing Duplicate File Notifications

body.zh-TW: 結束終端機並重新回到先前的工作進度時，對話狀態的延續能省下重複說明的時間。退出程式時顯示的恢復對話提示，現在會主動把最初啟動時帶上的旗標（例如 `--chrome --debug`）排在 `--resume` 前方，方便直接複製。恢復工作階段後，Claude 不會再收到它早已知曉的重複檔案變更通知。如果先前對話曾因工具被關閉而呼叫失敗，恢復後也不會再持續停用該內建工具。雲端與 SDK 工作階段在產生對話標題期間若收到新訊息或中斷指令，標題也不再無故丟失。
body.en: When exiting the terminal and returning to prior work progress, continuing session state saves time spent repeating explanations. The "Resume this session with" hint shown upon exiting now proactively places the flags you launched with (for example `--chrome --debug`) ahead of `--resume` for easy copying. After resuming a session, Claude will no longer receive duplicate notifications about file changes it already knew about. If an earlier conversation had a tool call fail because the tool was turned off, that built-in tool will no longer remain disabled after resuming. If cloud and SDK sessions receive a new message or Stop command while generating a conversation title, titles will no longer be lost for no reason.

items.original:
Fixed session titles being lost in cloud and SDK sessions when a new message or Stop arrived while the title was generating
Fixed resumed sessions telling Claude again about a file change it already knew about
Fixed Claude sometimes not using a built-in tool in a resumed session after an earlier call failed because the tool was switched off
Improved the "Resume this session with" hint shown at exit to repeat the flags you launched with (for example `--chrome --debug`) ahead of `--resume`

title.zh-TW: 改善外掛同步與無頭模式記憶體，擴充開發完成主動提議分享
title.en: Optimizing Plugin Sync and Headless Memory While Offering Mod Sharing Upon Completion

body.zh-TW: 在專案中安裝多個自訂技能與外掛程式時，背景同步與載入效率直接影響啟動體驗。在 headless（沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）中掛載大量註冊指令的外掛時，先前會佔用過高記憶體並拖慢啟動速度，現在載入流程已獲得改善。從 claude.ai 同步技能若遇上磁碟無法寫入，程式不會再每 10 分鐘重複下載或遺失技能。雲端工作階段中若同步的外掛包含相同伺服器，運作中的連接器也不會再被誤報為失敗或需要驗證。內建的 `plugin-authoring` 技能在確認你編寫的擴充模組運作正常後，會主動詢問一次是否需要協助分享。
body.en: When installing multiple custom skills and plugins in a project, background sync and loading efficiency directly impact the startup experience. In headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal visual interface), loading many plugins that register commands previously consumed excessive memory and slowed down startup, but the loading process has now been improved. If syncing skills from claude.ai encounters a disk that cannot be written to, the program will no longer repeatedly download them every 10 minutes or lose skills. If a synced plugin contains the same server during cloud sessions, working connectors will no longer be mistakenly reported as failed or needing authorization. After confirming that a mod you built works properly, the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill will proactively offer once to help share the mod.

items.original:
Fixed skills synced from claude.ai being lost or downloaded again every ten minutes when they can't be written to disk
Fixed Claude saying a working claude.ai connector needed authorization or had failed in cloud sessions when a synced plugin included the same server
Fixed high memory use and slow startup in headless sessions with many plugins that register commands
Changed the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill to offer once, after a mod you built works, to help share the mod

title.zh-TW: 管線寫入失敗改回傳代碼 1，修復啟動設定監聽與訊號重複
title.en: Returning Exit Code 1 on Pipeline Write Failures and Fixing Duplicate Signals

body.zh-TW: 自動化腳本在後台長時間運作時，任何靜默失敗或未釋放的程序都會累積成維運隱患。執行 `claude -p` 時若因硬碟空間或配額額度耗盡，導致對話紀錄或 `~/.claude.json` 寫入失敗，程式現在會印出錯誤訊息並以結束代碼 1 退出，不再誤報為成功代碼 0。在包含 `--setting-sources` 等跳過清理機制的環境上，過期的歷史紀錄檔現在會確實執行清理。程式剛啟動首秒內對設定檔所做的修改，現在會即時生效，不必等待下一次檔案異動。中止 Shell 指令時，子行程過去有時會收到兩次 SIGTERM 終止訊號而跳過自身的清理流程，該問題目前也已獲得解決。
body.en: When automated scripts run in the background for extended periods, any silent failure or unreleased process builds up operational risks. When running `claude -p`, if exhausted disk space or quota causes writes to transcripts or `~/.claude.json` to fail, the program now prints an error message and exits with code 1 rather than mistakenly reporting success with exit code 0. On environments where some runs skip cleanup mechanisms, such as those using `--setting-sources`, expired transcript files are now reliably cleaned up. Modifications made to settings files within the first second or so after startup now take effect immediately without waiting for another file change. When stopping a shell command, child processes previously sometimes received the SIGTERM signal twice and skipped their own cleanup routines, an issue that has now been resolved.

items.original:
Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or ~/.claude.json writes; it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1. Full NFS exports may be missed
Fixed edits to settings files made in the first second or so after launch not taking effect until a settings file changed again
Fixed old transcripts not being cleaned up on machines where some runs skip cleanup, such as runs using `--setting-sources`
Fixed child processes of a stopped shell command sometimes being sent SIGTERM twice, which could make some programs skip their cleanup

title.zh-TW: 團隊協作通訊與模式同步，修復終端清除輸入誤殺背景代理
title.en: Synchronizing Team Agent Communication and Modes While Preventing Input Clears from Halting Agents

body.zh-TW: 讓多位 AI 代理在後台分頭協作專案時，訊息投遞與執行模式的同步十分關鍵。透過 SendMessage 發送訊息給執行中的背景代理時，代理正在跑的指令會移入背景且不中斷，讓新訊息能更早送達。在命令列按下 Ctrl+C 清除輸入框文字時，先前會誤將所有背景代理一併中止，現在不再影響背景任務。在 tmux 或 iTerm2 分割視窗中啟動的團隊成員，會正確跟隨主控工作階段採用手動模式，不再擅自進入自動模式。隊友延遲送達的訊息不會再重建已刪除的收件匣，重啟的隊友也不會因先前的關閉審核被剔除，退出時對外掛監聽程序更會略過多餘的背景執行確認。
body.en: When having multiple AI agents collaborate on projects in the background, message delivery and execution mode synchronization are critical. When sending a message to a running background agent via SendMessage, the command currently running moves to the background without being stopped, allowing new messages to arrive earlier. When pressing Ctrl+C at the command line to clear typed text, it previously stopped all background agents by mistake, but it now no longer affects background tasks. Teammates started in tmux or iTerm2 panes will correctly follow the lead session in using manual mode rather than entering auto mode on their own. Delayed messages from teammates will no longer recreate deleted inboxes, restarted teammates will not be removed due to earlier shutdown approvals, and exit will skip the redundant "Background work is running" prompt for plugin monitors.

items.original:
Fixed deleted agent team inboxes being re-created by a teammate's late message
Fixed a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval
Fixed agent team teammates in tmux or iTerm2 panes starting in auto mode when the lead session was in manual mode
Fixed Ctrl+C stopping all running background agents when pressed to clear typed text at the prompt
Changed SendMessage so a message to a running background agent arrives earlier: its running command moves to the background, without being stopped
Changed exit to skip the "Background work is running" prompt for plugin monitors

title.zh-TW: 團隊新手導引刪除防呆，杜絕誤刪近期檔案與虛假成功提示
title.en: Guarding Team Onboarding Guide Deletion Against Accidental Removal and False Success Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你整理專案文件並要求 Claude 刪除團隊指引時，模糊指令可能導致意外刪除重要檔案。過去如果在輸入指令時要求刪除 `/team-onboarding` 導引卻沒有指明具體名稱，Claude 會擅自刪除最新更新過的那份檔案，現在已修正此危險行為。如果伺服器拒絕了刪除請求，Claude 也不會再假稱該檔案已被刪除，而是會誠實回報刪除失敗。⟦宛如交代助理銷毀公文卻沒說清檔號，以前對方會擅自挑最新那份拿去碎紙，機器拒絕還謊稱已辦妥；現在不再亂挑，而且失敗會誠實回報。⟧
body.en: When organizing project documents and asking Claude to delete team guides, ambiguous instructions could lead to accidental deletion of important files. Previously, when asked to delete a `/team-onboarding` guide without specifying a concrete name, Claude took the liberty of deleting the most recently updated file, a dangerous behavior that has now been corrected. If the server refuses a deletion request, Claude will no longer falsely claim that the file was deleted, but will instead honestly report that the deletion failed. ⟦Imagine instructing an assistant to destroy an official document without specifying the file number: previously, they would take the liberty of picking the most recently updated copy for the shredder and falsely claim it was done when the machine refused; now they no longer pick arbitrarily, and failures are reported honestly.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude deleting your most recently updated `/team-onboarding` guide when asked to delete one without naming which
Fixed Claude saying a `/team-onboarding` guide was deleted when the server refused the delete

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留歷史摘要，修正快取環境變數與子代理思考深度
title.en: Retaining Conversation Compaction Summaries While Correcting Cache Variables and Subagent Effort

body.zh-TW: 當對話長度接近上限觸發自動壓縮時，內容精簡的完整度直接關係到後續回答的精確度。在超長對話中，即使自動壓縮機制需要縮減自身的請求長度，也不會再遺失前段對話的摘要紀錄。若專案的 CLAUDE.md 內容龐大且在發送後發生異動，壓縮後也不會再跳出提示過長的錯誤。停用 prompt cache（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）的環境變數 `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` 與 `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET`，現在對帶有 `[1m]`、跨區域或無日期後綴的模型名稱都能確實生效。採用與主對話不同模型的子代理或隊友，則會改用該模型專屬的思考深度等級或預設值，不再盲目繼承主工作階段設定。
body.en: When conversation length nears the limit and triggers automatic compaction, the thoroughness of content streamlining directly affects the accuracy of subsequent answers. In very long conversations, even when the automatic compaction mechanism must shorten its own request length, it will no longer lose summaries of earlier conversation history. If a project has a massive CLAUDE.md that changed after being sent, a "Prompt is too long" error will no longer appear after compaction. The environment variables `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` and `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET` that disable prompt caching now reliably take effect on model names with `[1m]`, cross-region variants, or undated suffixes. Subagents or teammates using a different model from the main conversation will switch to that model's dedicated effort level or default value instead of blindly inheriting the main session's setting.

items.original:
Fixed "Prompt is too long" after automatic compaction in sessions whose very large CLAUDE.md changed since it was last sent
Fixed very long conversations losing their earlier summary when compaction had to shorten its own request
Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` and `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET` having no effect on `[1m]`, other-region and undated spellings of the default model
Changed subagents and teammates on a different model from the main conversation to use that model's saved effort level or its default, instead of the session's effort level

title.zh-TW: 讀取未變更檔案恢復回傳內文，修復搜尋超時與文件頁數計算
title.en: Restoring Full Content for Unchanged File Reads and Fixing Search Timeout Marking

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 閱讀專案程式碼或翻閱本機文件時，工具回傳的資料完整度決定了判斷的準確性。讀取工具（Read tool）先前在重複查看未變更檔案時僅回傳簡短存根，現在已移除該機制，重新讀取皆會傳回完整內容。搜尋工具在達到時間上限時，先前會把 Grep 和 Glob 的部分結果誤當成全部結果，現已修正為正確標記。在 PDF 自身後設資料異常時，Read 工具與 @ 標記過去會少算頁數，該問題也已排除。當個人成品累積超過 200 個時，`/artifacts` 與工具共享清單先前會顯示為空，現在皆能正常列出。設定為空的 `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` 會在 stdio MCP 伺服器中直接取消設定，使伺服器能順利取用主機既有的 AWS 憑證。
body.en: When asking Claude to read project code or browse local documents, the completeness of data returned by tools determines the accuracy of its judgments. The Read tool previously returned only a short stub when re-reading unchanged files, but this mechanism has been removed and reading an unchanged file now returns full content. When a search hits its time limit, search tools previously mistook partial Grep and Glob results for complete results, which has now been fixed with proper markings. When a PDF's own metadata was abnormal, the Read tool and @-mentions previously undercounted its pages, an issue that has now been eliminated. When you accumulate 200 or more of your own artifacts, `/artifacts` and the tool's shared list previously showed up empty, but they now display normally. An `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` configured as empty will now be directly unset in stdio MCP servers, enabling the server to smoothly access the machine's existing AWS credentials.

items.original:
Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving an empty `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` when their env config sets it to empty; the variable is now unset, so the server can use the machine's own AWS credentials
Fixed a PDF's own metadata being able to make Read and @-mentions under-count its pages
Fixed `/artifacts` and the Artifact tool's shared list showing no shared artifacts when you have 200 or more of your own
Fixed Claude treating partial Grep and Glob results as complete when a search hit its time limit
Removed the Read tool's "file unchanged since your last Read" stub: reading an unchanged file again returns its content

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制新增分支自動編號，修復重啟無回應與停用提示
title.en: Adding Automatic Fork Numbering in Remote Control and Fixing Restart Unresponsiveness

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端連線管理多個對話分支時，清晰的狀態回饋能讓切換操作井然有序。當全域設定 `disableRemoteControl` 停用遠端控制時，輸入 `/remote-control` 不再顯示未知的指令錯誤，而是明確告知該功能已被設定關閉。重啟 `claude remote-control` 後，若你在上一則訊息送出後一分鐘內又傳了下一則給閒置的工作階段，那則訊息過去有時沒人回應，現在已修好。而在建立對話分支且應用程式未自訂名稱時，長標題會保留結尾的 `(fork)` 標記。若對話是由 `claude remote-control` 啟動，原名稱的分支在再次複製時會自動命名為第二分支，方便快速辨識演變歷程。
body.en: When managing multiple conversation forks over remote connections, clear status feedback keeps switching operations orderly. When the global setting `disableRemoteControl` disables Remote Control, entering `/remote-control` no longer returns an "Unknown command" error, but clearly indicates that the feature has been turned off by configuration. After restarting `claude remote-control`, if you send another message to an idle session within one minute of your previous message, that message previously sometimes went unanswered, which has now been fixed. When creating conversation forks and the application does not set a custom name, long titles will retain their trailing `(fork)` tag. For sessions started with `claude remote-control`, forking a branch already named with a fork suffix automatically names it with `(fork 2)` to easily track evolutionary history.

items.original:
Fixed `/remote-control` answering "Unknown command" instead of saying that Remote Control is turned off by the `disableRemoteControl` setting
Remote Control: Improved fork names when the app doesn't set one: a long name keeps its "(fork)" ending, and in sessions started with `claude remote-control` a fork of "Name (fork)" is "Name (fork 2)"
[Remote Control] Fixed the next message to an idle session going unanswered after you restart `claude remote-control`, when you sent it within a minute of your previous message

title.zh-TW: PR 對話支援跨頁搜尋，改善螢幕報讀與 Slack 卡片呈現
title.en: Supporting Multi-Page PR Session Searches and Improving Screen Reader Announcements

body.zh-TW: 在日常團隊協作中調用輔助工具時，介面反饋的流暢度會直接影響操作專注度。在累積大量工作階段的專案中執行 `claude --from-pr` 時，若關聯的對話落在第一頁之後，過去會誤報找不到對話，現在已支援跨頁檢索。螢幕閱讀器模式在子代理執行時，先前每次數值變動都會反覆朗讀耗時與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），現在已消除這類多餘報讀。在 Slack 貼上成品連結時，卡片改以簡潔按鈕呈現並直接在 Claude 中開啟，不再擠入側邊欄。送出 `/feedback` 報告期間不會再多餘顯示按 Enter 確認的提示，`/design-sync` 遇到設計系統遷移時也會在建置前提前停止並說明。
body.en: When invoking auxiliary tools in daily team collaboration, smooth interface feedback directly affects operational focus. When running `claude --from-pr` in projects with many sessions, if the linked conversation fell beyond the first page, it previously mistakenly reported "No conversations found", but multi-page retrieval is now supported. In screen reader mode while a subagent runs, the system previously repeatedly read out elapsed time and tokens (units of text AI processes and bills for) on every update, but these redundant announcements have now been eliminated. When pasting artifact links in Slack, cards now present a simpler button to open directly in Claude rather than squeezing into the side panel. While sending a `/feedback` report, the prompt showing "Enter to confirm" is no longer shown unnecessarily. When encountering a design system migration, `/design-sync` will also stop early before building and explain the situation.

items.original:
Fixed `claude --from-pr` reporting "No conversations found" in projects with many sessions when the linked session was older than the first page
Fixed screen readers speaking a running subagent's elapsed time and token count on every change in screen reader mode
Fixed /feedback showing "Enter to confirm" while a report is being sent
Improved `/design-sync` to say up front when your design system has moved to Claude, and stop before building instead of failing at upload
[Claude Tag] Changed newly pasted artifact links in Slack to show a simpler card with an Open button that opens the artifact in Claude, instead of Slack's side panel

title.zh-TW: Windows 磁碟工作目錄辨識改進，修復 260 字元路徑限制
title.en: Windows Working Directory Detection Improved and 260-Character Path Limit Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上處理深層資料夾或特殊磁區時，路徑長度與格式常常是工具呼叫出錯的元兇。在部分原生路徑查詢失敗的 Windows 磁碟區上，過去所有的工具呼叫都會被拒絕執行，現在工作目錄檢查已改為比對資料夾本體識別碼，不再卡死。針對非透過桌面版啟動的工作階段，暫存草稿區與其他暫存路徑過去會隨著專案路徑累加變長，導致複製進來的儲存庫輕易撞上 260 個字元的路徑長度上限，目前路徑結構已調整縮短，避免了複製與寫入時的路徑長度報錯。⟦跟快遞核對送件地址一樣，以前地圖查不到路名就整批拒送，轉運標籤還越貼越長以致寫不下；現在改認建築代號放行，並精簡中繼標籤避免退件。⟧
body.en: When handling deep folders or special volumes on Windows systems, path length and formatting often cause tool calls to fail. On some Windows volumes where native path lookup fails, every tool call was previously refused, but the working-directory check now compares the folder's identity instead of stalling. For sessions not started by Claude Desktop, the session scratchpad and other temporary paths previously grew with the project path length, causing cloned repositories to hit the 260-character path limit; the path structure has now been shortened to prevent path length errors during cloning and writing. ⟦Just as a courier checking delivery addresses once refused an entire shipment when a map lookup failed and stacked transfer labels until they ran out of room, the service now identifies the building code instead and trims intermediate tags to prevent returns.⟧

items.original:
Windows: Fixed every tool call being refused on some volumes where the native path lookup fails; the working-directory check now compares the folder's identity instead
Windows: Fixed the session scratchpad and other temporary paths growing with your project's path length in sessions not started by Claude Desktop, which made repositories cloned into them hit the 260-character path limit

title.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件修復分支漏訊，補正逾時重啟與深度思考
title.en: VS Code Extension Fixes Dropped Messages in Forked Chats, Timeout Restarts, and Deep Thinking

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 編輯器內直接與 Claude 討論程式碼時，對話訊息的完整度攸關上下文推理。在延伸模組中分支（fork）對話時，先前平行執行的多個工具呼叫只會保留一個，且自動壓縮保留的末尾訊息常會遺失，導致回覆缺乏上下文，目前訊息遺失問題已排除。當 Claude 未及時完成啟動時，擴充套件會在報錯前自動嘗試重新啟動一次，防止訊息遺失。遇上區域或網路阻擋時，介面不再誤開登入畫面。即使關閉了遙測收集，`ultrathink` 指令現在依然能確實提升該輪思考深度並正常呈現彩虹特效。
body.en: When discussing code directly with Claude in VS Code, message completeness is essential for contextual reasoning. When forking conversations in the extension, only one of the tool calls run in parallel was previously kept, and trailing messages kept by automatic compaction were often lost, leaving responses without context; message loss has now been eliminated. When Claude does not finish starting in time, the extension now automatically attempts to start Claude once more before showing an error, preventing lost messages. The interface no longer mistakenly opens the sign-in screen when a request is blocked for its region or network. Even when telemetry collection is turned off, the `ultrathink` command now reliably raises effort for its turn and displays its rainbow animation.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed forked conversations dropping messages: only one of the tool calls Claude ran in parallel was kept, and the last messages a compaction kept were lost, which could leave Claude's answer without the question it answered
[VSCode] Fixed a message being lost when Claude did not finish starting in time: the extension now starts Claude once more before showing the error
[VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen opening when a request is blocked for its region or network
[VSCode] Fixed `ultrathink` not raising effort for its turn or showing its rainbow when telemetry is off

title.zh-TW: VS Code 面板字體隨設定縮放，檔案連結改開於獨立編輯群組
title.en: VS Code Panel Fonts Scale with Settings and File Links Open in a Separate Editor Group

body.zh-TW: 在編輯器側邊欄微調閱讀視圖與字級大小時，整體的視覺排版決定了查閱程式碼的舒適感。當你在設定中調大 `chat.fontSize` 時，Claude 面板中的附件標籤、功能選單、提示橫幅與對話方塊現在會同步放大，不再縮在角落顯得過小。在對話分頁中點擊檔案連結時，檔案會自動在另一個獨立編輯器群組中開啟，不再粗暴覆蓋掉當前的聊天對話畫面。帳號面板中方案名稱第二個單字先前誤顯示為全小寫的字型問題，也已經重新修正為正確大小寫。
body.en: When fine-tuning the reading view and font size in the editor sidebar, overall visual layout determines the comfort of reviewing code. When `chat.fontSize` is raised in settings, attachment chips, menus, banners, and dialogs in the Claude panel now scale up simultaneously instead of staying small in the corner. When clicking a file link in a chat tab, the file now opens in another separate editor group instead of abruptly replacing the current chat screen. In the Account panel, the typographical issue where the second word of a plan name was mistakenly displayed in lowercase has also been corrected to the proper casing.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the Account panel showing the plan name with a lower-cased second word
[VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening on top of the chat instead of in another editor group
[VSCode] Fixed attachment chips, menus, banners and dialogs in the Claude panel staying small when `chat.fontSize` is raised

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段新增連結卡片，改進管理介面與機密覆寫防護
title.en: Cloud Sessions Add Link Cards, Improve Admin Interface and Secret Overwrite Protection

body.zh-TW: 在雲端環境中與遠端伺服器互動時，彈出的外部連結與組織設定需要嚴謹的防護與清晰的視窗。當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器請求開啟網頁時，雲端工作階段會主動彈出連結卡片，讓你能自由選擇開啟或拒絕，不再讓請求在後台石沉大海。管理員設定中的機構環境對話方塊改為精簡版面，每個區段以橫列展開，未儲存的輸入在關閉前會主動跳出確認提示。若為已有網路機密的主機新增機密，表單會直接拒絕並指明現有機密，防止意外覆寫。新增排程任務時也會主動帶入機構管理員選定的預設環境，不再強制套用官方預設環境。
body.en: When interacting with remote servers in cloud environments, popup external links and organizational settings require rigorous protection and clear presentation. When an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server asks to open a webpage, cloud sessions now proactively display a link card so you can freely open or decline the link instead of letting the request go unseen in the background. The organization environment dialog in admin settings now uses a compact layout where each section opens from a row, and unsaved input prompts for confirmation before closing. If you add a network secret for a host that already has one, the form directly refuses and points to the existing secret to prevent accidental overwrites. Newly scheduled tasks also automatically populate with the default environment selected by the organization administrator instead of enforcing the official hosted default.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a link card to cloud sessions, so you can open or decline a link an MCP server asks you to visit instead of the request going unseen
[Cloud sessions] Changed the organization environment dialog in admin settings to the personal dialogs' short layout: each section opens from a row, and unsaved input asks before closing
[Cloud sessions] Fixed adding a network secret for a host that already has one silently replacing it; the Add secret form now refuses and points you to the existing secret
[Cloud sessions] Fixed new scheduled tasks ignoring your organization's default environment: the form now starts on the one an admin chose instead of the Anthropic-hosted default

entries: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off

Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's

title.zh-TW: Slack 跨頻道畫布可接續編輯，參與方式設定更名
title.en: Slack Cross-Channel Canvases Allow Continued Edits, Participation Setting Renamed

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 跨組織討論或跨頻道共用畫布時，你可能遇過回覆沒人接、Claude 拒絕編輯的狀況。以前 Claude 在頻道自己建立的 Canvas 畫布，另分享至其他頻道或私訊後，就會拒絕在原頻道編輯或追加內容；現在已恢復支援。在兩家公司皆啟用 Claude 的 Slack Connect 討論串中，未特別標註的回覆也不再因轉發至另一家公司的應用程式而漏接。雲端排程的即時清單現在能直接更新當次發出的頂層訊息，避免進度卡在未完成狀態。頻道 Configure 設定頁與 Claude Tag 管理設定中的自動回應開關，都改為「Claude 參與方式」選單。
body.en: When collaborating across organizations or sharing canvases across channels in Slack, you may have encountered unanswered replies or Claude refusing to edit. Previously, once a canvas Claude created in a channel was shared to another channel or a direct message, it refused to edit or append content from that channel; this support has now been restored. In Slack Connect threads where both organizations have enabled Claude, untagged replies no longer go unanswered when forwarded to the other organization's app. The live checklist for cloud scheduled tasks can now directly update top-level messages posted during that run, preventing progress from staying half-done. On a channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings, the Respond automatically switch has been changed to a "How Claude participates" menu.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
[Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
[Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
[Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段支援 MCP 表單填寫，密鑰管理與路徑顯示最佳化
title.en: Cloud Sessions Support MCP Form Completion, Secret Management and Path Display Refined

body.zh-TW: 當你透過瀏覽器切換雲端工作階段處理專案，各種互動提示與環境權限有了明確回饋。現在當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器提出表單請求，介面會跳出卡片讓你填寫或拒絕，不再無預警直接取消。切回雲端或 Remote Control 遠端控制工作階段時，若訊息還在同步更新，畫面會顯示「Catching up…」。企業版成員能在個人雲端環境新增或刪除網路密鑰，不再限制只能檢視。雲端工作階段的 Files 檔案面板搜尋，修好了 Claude 切換目錄後把資料夾顯示成 ../.. 路徑的問題，改為顯示自專案根目錄起算的路徑。變更面板的省略說明也收納成分支名稱旁的徽章。
body.en: When switching between cloud sessions in a browser to work on projects, interactive prompts and environment permissions now offer clearer feedback. Now, when an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server requests a form, a card pops up in the interface for you to fill in or decline instead of the request being canceled without warning. When switching back to a cloud or Remote Control session while messages are still updating, the screen displays "Catching up…". Enterprise members can now add and delete network secrets in their personal cloud environments, rather than being restricted to view-only access. In a cloud session's Files pane search, a bug where folders appeared as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory has been fixed, and paths now show from the project root. The note explaining what the Changes pane leaves out has also been moved into a badge beside the branch name.

items.original:
[Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
[Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
[Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
[Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
[Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root

title.zh-TW: VSCode 面板支援閘道登入，思考彩虹特效與介面控制項修復
title.en: VSCode Panel Supports Gateway Sign-In, Thinking Rainbow Effect and UI Controls Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 側邊欄與 Claude 協同撰寫程式碼時，登入內部服務與微調思考強度有了更完整的介面支援。現在聊天面板可直接登入企業的 Claude apps 閘道器，無須另外開啟終端機。在對話輸入 `ultrathink`，會讓當回合採用 `xhigh` 極高思考力度，並在聊天輸入框呈現彩虹效果。模型設定帶有 `[1m]` 標記時，Effort 思考力度滑桿、Ultracode 開關與模型名稱也都恢復顯示。設定檔出錯時，已儲存的 `/btw` 提問紀錄不會再被意外清除。若先前已指定手動審核修改，重新載入編輯器後也不會誤跳回自動模式。
body.en: When collaborating on code with Claude in the VSCode sidebar, signing in to internal services and fine-tuning thinking effort now have more complete interface support. The chat panel can now sign in directly to an enterprise Claude apps gateway without opening a separate terminal. Entering `ultrathink` in a conversation runs that turn at `xhigh` effort and displays a rainbow effect in the chat box. When model settings carry the `[1m]` tag, the Effort slider, Ultracode switch, and model name are restored. When a configuration file contains errors, saved `/btw` question history will no longer be wiped accidentally. If manual approval of edits was previously specified, reloading the editor will no longer mistakenly revert to Auto mode.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added sign-in to a Claude apps gateway from the chat panel, with no terminal needed
[VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
[VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
[VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查改採結構化卡片，分析頁新增嚴重度統計圖表
title.en: Code Review Adopts Structured Cards, Analytics Page Adds Severity Charts

body.zh-TW: 當你提交程式碼請 Claude 協助把關專案品質，產出的審查摘要與分析統計現在一目了然。從桌面版或網頁的 Code 分頁發起 `/code-review` 時，雲端與 `claude remote-control` 遠端控制工作階段會直接顯示結構化的審查結果卡片，取代純文字清單。分析頁面的嚴重程度卡片會顯示所選期間的問題總數、每日依嚴重程度堆疊的圖表，以及各級數量。執行 `/ultrareview`、雲端工作階段或雲端代理找不到 GitHub 遠端關聯時，訊息會指引你到 https://github.com/new 建立儲存庫；其中 `/ultrareview` 也不再推薦會被 `gh` 拒絕的指令。
body.en: When submitting code for Claude to review project quality, the resulting review summaries and analytical statistics are now immediately clear. Starting `/code-review` from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web now displays a structured findings card in cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions instead of a plain-text list. The findings-by-severity card on the analytics page shows the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and counts for each severity level. When `/ultrareview`, a cloud session, or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote, the message guides you to create a repository at https://github.com/new; in addition, `/ultrareview` no longer recommends a command that `gh` rejects.

items.original:
Improved `/code-review` started from the Code tab in Claude Desktop or on the web: cloud and `claude remote-control` sessions now show the findings card, not a plain-text list
Improved the messages shown when `/ultrareview`, a cloud session or a cloud agent finds no GitHub remote: they now say to create a repository at https://github.com/new, and `/ultrareview` no longer suggests a `gh` command that `gh` rejects
[Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

title.zh-TW: Bash 工具完整保留別名與函式，背景命令退出不再殘留
title.en: Bash Tool Retains Aliases and Functions, Background Commands No Longer Linger on Exit

body.zh-TW: 當你透過終端機交由 Claude 執行腳本，自訂 Shell（執行指令的環境）的相容性有了修正。macOS 或 Linux 上，Claude Code 因憑證遭拒或雲端工作階段歸檔而自行退出時，不再留下仍執行中的命令。Bash 工具不再弄亂或遺失含換行的別名，但不含 Git Bash；減號開頭的函式名稱也已修好。匯出 `SHELLOPTS` 的腳本不再執行第一句就停擺。Windows 的 Git Bash 若在 rc 啟動設定檔同時設定 errexit 與 pipefail，且只定義 winpty 別名或沒有別名，也不再遺失別名與函式。PowerShell 掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式）的指令以型別轉換、`param`、`using` 或屬性開頭時，也能依結束代碼 2 阻擋執行。
body.en: When having Claude run scripts through the terminal, compatibility with a custom shell (an environment for running commands) has been improved. On macOS or Linux, when Claude Code exits on its own because credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived, it no longer leaves running commands behind. The Bash tool no longer garbles or loses aliases containing line breaks—except in Git Bash—and functions whose names start with a dash are now fixed. Scripts that export `SHELLOPTS` no longer stall right after their first command. In Windows Git Bash, when an rc startup file sets both errexit and pipefail while defining only winpty aliases or none at all, aliases and functions are no longer lost. When commands in PowerShell hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) start with a type cast, `param`, `using`, or an attribute, they also properly block execution on exit code 2.

items.original:
Fixed shell commands being left running on macOS and Linux when Claude Code exits by itself, for example when credentials are refused or a cloud session is archived
Fixed bash aliases with line breaks in their value (except in Git Bash), and functions whose names start with a dash, being garbled or lost in the Bash tool's shell
Fixed bash scripts started from the Bash tool stopping after their first command when `SHELLOPTS` is exported
Fixed PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2 when the command begins with a type cast, `param`, `using` or an attribute
Windows: Fixed the Bash tool losing your aliases and functions in Git Bash when the rc file sets errexit and pipefail and only winpty aliases, or none, are defined

title.zh-TW: 自動模式權限規則防意外覆寫，中斷狀態與伺服器判定修復
title.en: Auto Mode Permission Rules Prevent Accidental Overwrites, Interruption Status and Server Verdicts Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在自動模式下讓 Claude 連續執行任務時，權限清單與中斷原因不該讓你摸不著頭緒。受管理的 `autoMode.allow` 允許清單未含 `"$defaults"` 時，不再因主應用程式的 `--settings`、首次在 `/permissions` 加規則或 `/auto-mode-setup`，而加回內建例外；排程任務提示的內建規則也不會因此被移除。雲端工作階段與排程任務若因伺服器未回傳安全判定、由自動模式停止該回合，會確實標記失敗。背景代理仍在執行時，`claude -p` 文字輸出也會交代自動模式停止回合的原因。由主應用程式啟動、經代理伺服器或 LLM 大型語言模型閘道器連線且關閉實驗性測試功能時，環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` 不再被忽略。
body.en: When having Claude run tasks continuously in auto mode, permission lists and reasons for interruptions should never leave you guessing. When a managed `autoMode.allow` list omits "$defaults", built-in exceptions are no longer reintroduced by a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`; nor is the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts removed because of this. Cloud sessions and scheduled tasks are now properly marked as failed when auto mode stops a turn because the server returned no safety verdict. While a background agent is still running, `claude -p` text output also explains why auto mode stopped a turn. In sessions started by a host application through a proxy or an LLM (large language model) gateway with experimental features turned off, the `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` environment variable is no longer ignored.

items.original:
Fixed a managed `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` getting the built-in exceptions back from a host app's `--settings`, a first rule added in `/permissions`, or `/auto-mode-setup`
Fixed cloud sessions and cloud scheduled tasks not being marked as failed when auto mode stopped a turn because the server returned no safety verdict
Fixed `claude -p` text output sometimes not saying why auto mode stopped a turn when a background agent was still running
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` being ignored in sessions started by a host application (such as Claude Desktop) behind a proxy or LLM gateway with experimental betas turned off
Changed auto mode so that an `autoMode.allow` list without `"$defaults"` no longer removes the built-in rule on scheduled-task prompts

title.zh-TW: 憑證錯誤提示列出具體解法，保留私有 CA 所需的交叉憑證
title.en: Certificate Errors Detail Actionable Fixes, Retaining Cross-Certificates for Private CAs

body.zh-TW: 當工具在企業內網或受管網路發送請求，遇到連線驗證失敗時不再只丟出一行模糊代碼。⟦跟海關查驗護照上的簽證戳章一樣，如果發現缺少中介審核章，系統會直接指出漏蓋了哪一關，而不是冷冷關閉閘門。⟧現在遇到 SSL 憑證錯誤，終端機會直接分析可能原因，例如伺服器遺漏了中介憑證，並附上具體的修正指引。針對需要內部私有憑證的架構，可啟用環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP`，保留系統中循環互簽的交叉憑證。另外，當伺服器回傳的壓縮資料中途截斷或損毀時，網路請求也不會再無限期卡死。
body.en: When tools send requests across an enterprise intranet or managed network, connection verification failures no longer throw a vague line of code. ⟦Just like customs inspecting visa stamps in a passport, if an intermediate verification stamp is missing, the system points out exactly which checkpoint was skipped instead of coldly shutting the gate.⟧ Now when an SSL certificate error occurs, the terminal directly analyzes likely causes, such as a server omitting an intermediate certificate, and provides specific remediation instructions. For architectures requiring internal private certificates, you can enable the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` environment variable to retain cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop. In addition, network requests will no longer hang indefinitely if compressed data returned by a server is cut off or corrupted midway.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP` to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one
Fixed some network requests hanging when a compressed response was cut off or corrupted
Improved SSL certificate errors to name the likely causes, among them a server that leaves out an intermediate certificate, and the fix for each

title.zh-TW: 閘道器支援群組共用預算，階層政策與 Bedrock 防護標籤上線
title.en: Gateway Supports Pooled Group Budgets, Layered Policies and Bedrock Guardrail Tagging Released

body.zh-TW: 管理團隊花費與權限時，Claude apps 閘道器有了新選項。花費限制管理 API 的 `pooled_budget` 可設群組每月共用預算，各人仍有個別上限。`managed.policy_mode: layered` 套用所有相符政策，上方覆蓋下方。Bedrock 上游的 `guardrail.input_tagging` 加上提示詞攻擊篩選標籤；`all_messages_and_system` 也替系統提示詞加標籤。請求內每個模型都會檢查 `availableModels`、`deniedModels`、`models`；被封鎖時回傳 400 錯誤並指出對應欄位。強制使用閘道器時，終端機的 `claude auth login` 會顯示其登入入口。Team／Enterprise 從 Anthropic API 取得的受管理設定免確認套用；儲存副本驗證失敗就拒用。
body.en: When managing team spend and permissions, the Claude apps gateway has new options. The `pooled_budget` field on the spend limits admin API can set a monthly shared budget for a group on top of each member's individual limit. Setting `managed.policy_mode: layered` applies all matching policies, merging each over the ones listed below it. On Bedrock upstreams, `guardrail.input_tagging` adds prompt attack filter tags; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt. Every model named in a request is checked against `availableModels`, `deniedModels`, and `models`; if blocked, a 400 error is returned naming the relevant field. When a gateway is required, running `claude auth login` in a terminal shows the gateway sign-in prompt. Managed settings fetched from the Anthropic API for Team and Enterprise accounts apply without confirmation, and any stored copy that fails verification is rejected.

items.original:
Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with `pooled_budget` on the spend limits admin API
Added `managed.policy_mode: layered` to the Claude apps gateway: every policy that matches a developer applies, each merged over the ones listed below it, not only the first
Added `guardrail.input_tagging` on Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, which wraps prompts in the input tags that an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's prompt attacks filter needs; `all_messages_and_system` also tags the system prompt
Fixed the Claude apps gateway not checking every model a request names against `availableModels`, `deniedModels` and `models`; a request that names a blocked model now gets a 400 naming the field
Fixed `claude auth login` refusing to run where managed settings require a Claude apps gateway; in a terminal it now shows the gateway sign-in
Changed server-managed settings for Team and Enterprise logins: settings fetched from Anthropic's API now apply without an approval prompt, and a stored copy that doesn't verify is refused

title.zh-TW: Opus 4.8 快速模式排定退場，三個模型別名修復自動備援
title.en: Opus 4.8 Fast Mode Slated for Deprecation, Three Model Aliases Restore Fallback

body.zh-TW: 當你在多個雲端平台切換不同版本的 Claude 模型，版本遷移與容錯機制有了具體指引。Opus 4.8 快速模式自 2026 年 10 月 30 日起棄用，將於 11 月 30 日移除；移除後的快速模式請求會報錯，不會回退標準版，需遷移至 Opus 5.5 才能保有加速。在 Vertex AI 與 Amazon Bedrock 上，`sonnet`、`opus`、`haiku` 這三個模型別名，若最新版尚未向帳號或區域開放，會切換至相容舊版提供備援，不再於工作階段中途報錯。若用 `/model <id>` 輸入此版本未辨識的型號，也會主動跳出警告，提醒自動壓縮將預設採用 200K 的上下文視窗容量，也就是可容納的對話量。
body.en: When switching between different Claude model versions across multiple cloud platforms, version migration and fault tolerance now have clear guidance. Fast mode for Opus 4.8 has been deprecated as of October 30, 2026, and will be removed on November 30, 2026; once removed, fast mode requests will return an error rather than falling back to standard Opus 4.8, requiring migration to Opus 5.5 to maintain speedups. On Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock, the `sonnet`, `opus`, and `haiku` model aliases now switch to a compatible older version to provide fallback if the newest release is not yet available to your account or region, rather than failing mid-session. Entering an unrecognized model with `/model <id>` now triggers a warning that auto-compact will assume a 200K context window (the conversation volume it can hold).

items.original:
Deprecated fast mode for Opus 4.8 as of October 30, 2026; it will be removed on November 30, 2026. After removal, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error and do not fall back to standard Opus 4.8. Migrate to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup
Fixed `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` on Vertex AI and Amazon Bedrock showing an error mid-session instead of switching to an older model when the newest is not yet available to the account or region
Fixed `/model <id>` not warning when the model isn't recognized by this version and auto-compact will assume a 200K context window

title.zh-TW: 子代理可設定預設運算力度，支援關閉深度思考關鍵字
title.en: Subagents Support Default Effort Settings, Deep Thinking Keyword Can Be Disabled

body.zh-TW: 當你指派背景子代理分頭調查程式庫，任務的思考深度與模型繼承現在能精細掌控。如果團隊不想觸發額外的高強度推論，可透過環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` 直接停用 `ultrathink` 關鍵字。針對後台衍生出的子代理（處理專案分支任務的助手），只有在其他來源都未指定運算力度時，才會使用 `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT`，取代預設繼承主工作階段力度的行為。繼承了上層子代理專屬模型的助手，在被背景通知或新訊息喚醒後，也能持續鎖定指定模型，不會意外跳回主對話模型。
body.en: When dispatching background subagents (helpers that handle branching project tasks) to investigate a codebase, thinking depth and model inheritance can now be finely controlled. If a team prefers not to trigger extra high-intensity reasoning, the `ultrathink` keyword can be disabled directly via the `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK` environment variable. For subagents spawned in the background, `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` is used only when no other source specifies an effort level, replacing the default behavior of inheriting the main session's effort. Helpers that inherit a parent subagent's dedicated model will also stay locked to that assigned model after being awakened by a background notification or new message, rather than unexpectedly reverting to the main conversation model.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK`, which turns the `ultrathink` keyword off
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT` to set the effort level subagents run at when nothing else names one, instead of inheriting the session's
Fixed sub-agents that inherited a parent sub-agent's model moving to the main model when a background job or message woke them

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器與外掛環境修復，改善 SDK 與產物規則載入
title.en: Fixes for self-hosted runners and plugin environments, with improved SDK and Artifact rule loading

body.zh-TW: 自行架設執行環境或撰寫外掛整合時，跨機器狀態與規則顯示不再莫名出錯。自架執行器的工作階段換機後，MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器開關狀態不再遺失；按下停止並替換程序後，也不再答覆工作中傳入的舊訊息。外掛的憑證環境變數設為 `1` 等開關值時，`headersHelper` 腳本收到的 `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` 與伺服器網址不再損毀。SDK（軟體開發工具包）的 `register_repo_root` 請求，在 `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1` 下能載入工作目錄外的 `CLAUDE.md`。產物工具不再把 `self` 自身層級的資料庫存取規則顯示為問號；拒絕會移除這些規則的重新發布時，也會引用這些規則。
body.en: When hosting your own execution environments or writing plugin integrations, cross-machine state and rule displays no longer encounter unexplained errors. After a self-hosted runner session moves to a new machine, the on/off switch state of an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) server is no longer lost. After pressing Stop and replacing the process, it also no longer answers old messages sent while Claude was working. When a plugin credential environment variable is set to a switch value such as `1`, the `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL received by `headersHelper` scripts are no longer corrupted. With `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`, the SDK (software development kit) `register_repo_root` request can now load `CLAUDE.md` from outside the working directory. The Artifact tool no longer displays artifact database access rules at the `self` level as question marks, and now quotes those rules back when refusing a republish that would drop them.

items.original:
Fixed plugin MCP `headersHelper` scripts receiving a corrupted `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` and server URL when a credential-named environment variable was set to a switch value such as `1`
Fixed the SDK `register_repo_root` control request not loading the CLAUDE.md of a directory outside the working directory (with `CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1`)
Fixed the Artifact tool showing `?` for artifact database access rules at the `self` level, and not quoting those rules back when it refuses a republish that would drop them
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being answered after a Stop, once the session's process had been replaced
Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server's on/off switch sometimes being lost when a session moved to a new machine

title.zh-TW: 提示詞輸入清理不可見字元，介面提示與問卷送出機制修正
title.en: Invisible character cleaning in prompt input, with fixes for interface hints and survey submissions

body.zh-TW: 日常在命令列輸入提問與檢視提示時，多處影響打字節奏的介面細節得到了改善。以前從網頁複製文字若夾帶不可見字元，常需連按兩次 Enter 才能送出；現在普通提問第一次按下就會清除這些字元並發送，指令仍保留審查確認步驟。語音輸入提示不再於單一工作階段內耗盡三次顯示額度，未綁定按住說話的熱鍵時，也不再出現空白鍵帽。在窄視窗終端機初次啟動時，安全說明與終端機設定說明都不再漏字。若對話尚在儲存時執行過 `/clear` 清除或 `/resume` 接續指令，還原對話時也能恢復原本的任務計畫。企業問卷輸入 `1` 或 `0` 後，不再因短暫停頓就送出，必須按 Enter 才會確認。
body.en: When entering prompts and viewing hints in daily command-line use, multiple interface details that affect typing rhythm have been improved. Previously, copying text from web pages that contained invisible characters often required pressing Enter twice to send. Plain prompts now clean these characters and send on the first Enter press, while commands still retain the review confirmation step. The voice input hint no longer uses up its quota of three showings in a single session, and an empty keycap no longer appears when push-to-talk is unbound. During first-run startup in narrow terminal windows, security notes and terminal setup explanations no longer drop words. If `/clear` or `/resume` was run while a conversation was still being saved, resuming the conversation now also restores the original task plan. After typing `1` or `0` in the Enterprise survey, answers are no longer submitted due to a short pause, and now require pressing Enter to confirm.

items.original:
Fixed prompts containing invisible characters needing a second Enter to send; plain prompts now send cleaned on the first Enter, and commands still wait for review
Fixed the "hold space to speak" hint using up its three showings in one session, and showing an empty key when push-to-talk is unbound
Fixed a rare case where resuming a conversation did not restore its plan, when `/clear` or `/resume` had been run while part of that conversation was still being saved
Fixed first-run setup dropping words from the security notes and the terminal-setup explanation in narrow terminals
Fixed the Enterprise survey card taking a typed 1 or 0 after a short pause; a typed answer now needs Enter

title.zh-TW: 受限工作階段不再上傳目錄外檔案，比對與搜尋效能改善
title.en: Restricted sessions no longer upload files outside directories, with diff and search performance improvements

body.zh-TW: 當你在大型專案中比對程式碼變更或搜尋檔案，檔案上傳範圍與回應速度更為可靠。⟦恰似廠區門禁嚴格核對出入清單，即使持有特殊通行證，非指定作業區的機密文件一律禁止攜出大門。⟧以往在 `--restricted` 受限工作階段中，即使工作目錄外的檔案有 Read 讀取允許規則涵蓋，仍不該被上傳；現在已修好這項上傳限制。在大型儲存庫輸入 `/diff` 查看差異時，每次重新整理通常少執行一個掃描整個儲存庫的 Git 命令，並在 Git 反應變慢時自動拉開重新整理間隔。針對 Windows 使用者，Grep 與 Glob 搜尋工具在觸發逾時停止時，也不會再因搜尋行程未順利結束而無止境卡住畫面。
body.en: When comparing code changes or searching files across large projects, file upload scope and responsiveness are now more reliable. ⟦A factory security checkpoint strictly checks the entry and exit list: even with a special pass, confidential documents outside designated work areas are strictly barred from being carried out the gate.⟧ Previously in `--restricted` sessions, files outside working directories were not supposed to be uploaded even when covered by a Read allow rule. This upload restriction has now been fixed. When entering `/diff` in large repositories to inspect changes, each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository Git command, and refresh intervals are automatically spaced out when Git responds slowly. For Windows users, Grep and Glob search tools no longer freeze the screen indefinitely when a search process is killed at timeout but fails to exit cleanly.

items.original:
Fixed `--restricted` sessions uploading files from outside the working directories when a Read allow rule covered them
Fixed Grep and Glob never returning when the search process is killed at the timeout but does not exit, seen on Windows
Improved `/diff` on large repositories: each refresh usually runs one fewer full-repository git command, and refreshes are spaced out when git is slow

title.zh-TW: 嚴格限制寫入目錄，防止修改專案範圍外的檔案
title.en: Strictly Restricting Write Directories to Prevent Modifying Files Outside Project Boundaries

items.original: Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode

title.zh-TW: 應用程式閘道支援群組分流，完善防護紀錄與逾時修復
title.en: Application Gateways Support Group Routing, Refined Guardrail Logging, and Timeout Fixes

body.zh-TW: 企業內部透過應用程式閘道派發請求時，往往需要依據開發團隊的身分劃分不同線路。現在閘道上游新增了選填群組名單，只有在身分提供者群組內的開發者才會被導向指定上游，發生備援切換時也維持相同規則。針對 Amazon Bedrock 上游新增了防護追蹤設定，會記錄觸發了哪一項安全過濾機制而不會印出比對文字。此外修正了 Vertex 上游遇到 Google 憑證端點無回應而卡住數分鐘的問題，過期金鑰的啟動警告文字也一併修正。⟦彷彿機場海關依護照類別分流通道，指定身分的旅客才能走專屬查驗線，遇到轉機換櫃也維持相同安檢標準。⟧
body.en: When routing requests through an application gateway inside an enterprise, teams often need to divide routes based on developer identities. Gateway upstreams now add an optional group list so only developers in identity provider groups are directed to the designated upstream, maintaining the same rule during failover. For Amazon Bedrock upstreams, a new guardrail trace setting logs which safety filter fired without printing the matched text. In addition, an issue where a Vertex upstream hung for minutes when a Google credential endpoint was unresponsive has been fixed, and the startup warning message for expired keys was also corrected. ⟦Like airport customs dividing lanes by passport category, only travelers with designated identities can use the dedicated inspection lane, and the same security standards are maintained when switching transfer counters.⟧

items.original:
Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too
Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text
Fixed a Claude apps gateway Vertex upstream hanging for minutes when a Google token endpoint accepts the connection and never answers
Fixed the Claude apps gateway's start-up warning for a deprecated Claude Desktop key that it still serves as written saying "stops being accepted" after the key's end date

title.zh-TW: 閒置對話自動整理摘要，支援主流雲端平台與掛鉤防護
title.en: Automatic Summaries for Idle Conversations, Major Cloud Platform Support, and Hook Safeguards

body.zh-TW: 把長對話擱置在編輯器一旁後，重新提問時往往會因為超出長度而耗費額外的處理資源。VS Code 與 Claude Desktop 新增了閒置壓縮機制。只要對話超過 20 萬個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）且處於閒置，系統便會預先產出摘要。⟦宛若會計事務所利用午休裝訂憑證，以前案卷散落會拖慢查帳，現在趁離席空檔將過期單據濃縮成總表，回到座位便能直接對帳。⟧一旦快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）過期，下一次送出訊息就會直接使用這份摘要。這項機制現在也開放給關閉遙測的使用者，以及開啟一小時快取的 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 與各大閘道。壓縮前掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）輸出若過大，內容會硬性截斷在 10,000 字元以內，避免對話壓縮失敗。
body.en: Leaving long conversations sitting aside in an editor often consumes extra processing resources due to excessive length when asking follow-up questions. VS Code and Claude Desktop have added an idle compaction mechanism. Whenever a conversation exceeds 200,000 tokens (text units processed and billed by AI) and sits idle, the system generates a summary in advance. ⟦Imagine an accounting firm binding vouchers during lunch break: scattered case files previously slowed down audits, but now outdated receipts are condensed into summary sheets during breaks away from desks, letting accountants reconcile accounts immediately upon returning.⟧ Once the cache expires, your next message will directly use this summary. This mechanism is now also available for users with telemetry turned off, as well as Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and major gateways with one-hour caching enabled. If output from pre-compact hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) is too large, the content is strictly truncated to 10,000 characters to prevent compaction failures.

items.original:
Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired
Fixed a PreCompact hook with very large output making compaction fail or repeat; each hook's output is now cut at 10,000 characters
Changed idle compaction to also run for subscribers with telemetry turned off, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and LLM gateways once the one-hour prompt cache is on

title.zh-TW: 調適組織思考強度上限，遇部署缺漏自動切換相容模型
title.en: Adapting to Organization Effort Caps and Auto-Switching to Compatible Models on Missing Deployments

body.zh-TW: 團隊若對模型存取設有限制，工作階段常因為參數超標或缺少部署而突然中斷。若組織管理員限制了思考強度上限，現在遇到參數無效時會自動調降強度、重新嘗試並告知使用等級。在 Microsoft Foundry 缺少預設模型部署時，會自動切換至同系列的舊版模型作為備援。受管設定釘選模型後，Bedrock 與 Vertex 不會再於每次啟動時跳出升級提示。即使個人外掛程式清單損壞，也不再阻擋模型切換。此外，復原或繼續工作階段時會保留原本未知的自訂模型名稱，而遇到要求被標記時，若設定允許也會嘗試改用其他可用模型重送。以前在嚴格受管的環境下切換或復原模型容易直接報錯卡死，現在系統會自主尋找相容配置維持對話順暢。
body.en: When teams place restrictions on model access, sessions often abruptly halt due to parameter limits or missing deployments. If an organization administrator caps thinking effort, invalid parameters now automatically trigger a lower effort level, a retry, and a notice stating the level used. When Microsoft Foundry lacks a deployment for the default model, the system automatically falls back to an older model in the same family. After managed settings pin a model, Bedrock and Vertex will no longer display upgrade prompts on every startup. Even if a personal plugin manifest is broken, model switching is no longer blocked. In addition, restoring or resuming a session preserves unrecognized custom model names, and flagged requests will attempt to retry on another available model if settings permit. Where switching or resuming models in strictly managed environments previously threw errors and halted, the system now autonomously finds compatible configurations to keep conversations flowing smoothly.

items.original:
Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
Fixed Microsoft Foundry sessions failing when the resource has no deployment for the default Sonnet, Opus or Haiku model: Claude Code now falls back to an older model of that family
Fixed model switching being refused on machines with managed plugin settings when one of your own `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` plugins had a broken manifest or failed to download
Fixed the Bedrock and Vertex model upgrade offer coming back at every start when managed settings pin the model
Fixed `--resume`, and rewinding past a switch to another model after a refusal, moving a session on a model name Claude Code doesn't recognize to a different model
Changed flagged requests to retry on another model, not end in a refusal, when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`, `availableModels` or `deniedModels` leaves only an older Opus model, or none

title.zh-TW: 修正命令列非零結束代碼，強化憑證驗證與背景執行
title.en: Command-Line Non-Zero Exit Code Fix, Certificate Verification, and Background Execution

body.zh-TW: 在腳本或自動化管線中呼叫指令列工具時，若錯誤沒有正確回報，常會導致除錯方向徹底偏差。現在使用 `claude -p` 啟動失敗時，會印出錯誤原因並以結束代碼 1 離開，不再靜默回傳成功。當系統憑證庫（certificate store，存放根憑證的地方）中更新後的根憑證由前一版根憑證交叉簽署時，TLS 連線不再因找不到簽發者而中斷。背景常駐程式啟動失敗時，也不再誤報成執行檔已被刪除。另外，包含指令輸出標籤的提示能正確向本機回應，而將 `FORCE_HYPERLINK` 設為 `false`、`no` 或 `off` 都會關閉終端機超連結。
body.en: When calling command-line tools in scripts or automated pipelines, failing to report errors correctly often misguides debugging efforts. When startup fails with `claude -p`, the tool now prints the error cause and exits with code 1 instead of silently returning success. When a renewed root certificate in the system certificate store (a repository holding root certificates) is cross-signed by its predecessor, TLS connections no longer fail due to missing issuers. Background daemon startup failures are also no longer misreported as deleted binaries. Additionally, prompts containing command output tags acknowledge correctly to the local host, and setting `FORCE_HYPERLINK` to `false`, `no`, or `off` turns off terminal hyperlinks.

items.original:
Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1
Fixed TLS connections failing with `UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT` when the system certificate store holds a renewed root certificate that is cross-signed with its predecessor
Fixed prompts containing tags such as `<bash-stdout>` or `<local-command-stdout>` not being acknowledged to a local stream-json host
Fixed background sessions that fail to start being reported as a deleted daemon binary when the binary is still on disk
Changed `FORCE_HYPERLINK=false` (also `no` and `off`) to turn hyperlinks off instead of on

title.zh-TW: 改善長篇文件與多圖處理，長度超標主動提示未讀範圍
title.en: Handling Long Documents and Multiple Images with Proactive Notices for Unread Content

body.zh-TW: 對話中一旦傳送大量截圖或長篇文件，輸入內容過大常會讓遠端工具無聲無息地遺漏資訊。現在在 Bedrock 工作階段中堆積過多圖片時，執行壓縮會主動移除舊圖片來順利縮減長度，不再每次回覆都卡在輸入過長的錯誤。在遠端 Linux 主機透過 SSH 連線時，若嘗試直接貼上圖片，提示框會明確指引你將檔案複製到主機並貼上路徑，不再毫無反應。⟦恰似快遞收發中心處理超重包裹，以前遇到箱子塞不下便直接拒收或偷偷扣件，現在會主動分裝打包並在清單上清楚註明未裝入的項目。⟧在 Cowork 雲端工作階段中使用網頁抓取工具讀取 PDF 時，若文字內容超出 10 萬字元，會主動說明有多少內容未被讀取以及如何接續查閱。
body.en: Once conversations receive large numbers of screenshots or long documents, oversized inputs often cause remote tools to silently miss information. When too many images accumulate in Bedrock sessions, compacting now actively removes older images to reduce length smoothly, rather than getting stuck on input-too-long errors on every turn. When connecting via SSH to a remote Linux host, attempting to paste an image directly now prompts you to copy the file over and paste its path instead of doing nothing silently. ⟦Just as a courier dispatch center handles overweight packages, where previously overfilled boxes were rejected outright or items were quietly withheld, staff now proactively repack shipments into separate parcels and clearly note unincluded items on the manifest.⟧ When using web fetching tools to read PDFs in Cowork cloud sessions, if text exceeds 100,000 characters, the tool proactively explains how much content was unread and how to continue reading.

items.original:
Fixed Bedrock sessions with many images failing every turn and `/compact` with "400 Input is too long." instead of removing older images and compacting
Fixed pasting an image over SSH to a Linux machine doing nothing silently; the prompt now says to copy the file over and paste its path
Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions silently dropping a PDF's text past 100,000 characters; it now says how much was unread and where to read on
